reasons.action: The caller explicitly asks for a new behavior — the car pulling forward — so the requested action governs; there is no visual reference action to inherit.
reasons.medium: The rendering medium is already settled by the no-reference medium decision; with no visual reference, no observed medium can govern, so the request position governs.
reasons.wardrobe: The only supplied reference is an audio SFX asset, which cannot establish any observed clothing or accessory, so the request position governs by default.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies observed lighting; the audio rumble carries no illumination information, so the request position governs the scene light.
reasons.framing: No actual camera composition, shot scale or viewpoint is supplied by the audio reference, so the request position governs framing.
reasons.palette: No visual reference provides an observed grade or palette to retain; the audio asset cannot supply color or tonal treatment, so the request position governs.
